" Bobadilla, having been sent by Ferdinand and Isabella to Hispaniola, to inquire into the conduct of Columbus, seized upon his property, and ordered him to be thrown into irons, but as no armourer or smith could be found willing to lend himself to so disgraceful a proceeding, it was feared that this order could not be accomplished, until his own cook DUVALL, volunteered to rivet them upon him. In this state he was sent to Europe. A ruffian took his cloak from him as he was being conveyed on board ship.
